name: @local/dsh-hub-bundle
description: DSH Hub Meta-Bundle — Enables Persona Wardrobe, Pure Event Hub, GitHub Connector, Proactive Memo Trigger & macOS WeChat Connector together

scripts.build: sh -c 'if [ -d src ] && find src -name "*.ts" | grep -q .; then tsc -p tsconfig.json; fi'
scripts.test: sh -c 'if [ -d test ] && find test -name "*.test.ts" | grep -q .; then tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "lib-test/test/**/*.test.js"; fi'
